subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 9 8 5 8 8 9 8 6 2 6 1 4 4 7 9 9 4 8 1 7 5 6 8 6 5 6 9 (Right)

How many such odd numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?15352
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 9 8 5 8 8 9 8 6 2 6 1 4 4 7 9 9 4 8 1 7 5 6 8 6 5 6 9 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Odd — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd5a712e1f7b8a5c7cd3382cdf0e36abad8aa59727a023fc7ba17a5ff115a687.png] 

 

Thus, there are 2 such odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
